# PR #3765: Patch: split e2e smoke into four shards

Closes #3764

I raised `[e2e] smoke` in `scripts/ci-shards.toml` from 2 to 4 and rewrote the comment above it. `bot selftest` will go red until a person edits `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py`, which the bot may not touch. The change fixes the split only on paper: I had no timings, so whether each shard now finishes under 5 minutes is unproven until CI runs.

## What changed
Only `scripts/ci-shards.toml` changed. The new comment records the 8m 7s and 8m 57s runs (#3764), the four-shard split, and the two limits on the count. It can't exceed the 7 smoke specs, and 8 is the cap (`MAX_SHARDS` in `matrix.py`).

## Checks I ran
- **Shard split.** `cd e2e && for k in 1 2 3 4; do node scripts/shard-specs.mjs --smoke $k 4; done` printed four non-empty shards. Each of the seven specs appears once:

  | Shard | Specs |
  |---|---|
  | 1 | 19 |
  | 2 | 01 |
  | 3 | 06, 10, 46 |
  | 4 | 13, 47 |

- **Generator.** `matrix.outputs()['e2e_smoke_shards']` printed `[1, 2, 3, 4]`.
- **`cd bot && python3 -m unittest tests.test_ci_matrix`.** 3 of 15 tests fail, as the plan expected. I saw the traceback only for `test_the_web_and_e2e_counts_come_from_the_file`, which looks for `smoke = 2` and no longer finds it. I took the other two from the plan's list and didn't read their output.
- **Not run.** The cargo, web and spec checks. A TOML count doesn't touch what they cover.

## A person must do
- **`bot selftest` goes red.** `scripts/ci-shards.toml` isn't in the `bot` scope list of `ci.yml`'s `changes` job. The test may therefore be skipped on the PR and fail on the merge queue or `main` instead. The same break happened with #3585 and was fixed in #3625.
- **Edits to `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py`:**
  1. In `test_the_committed_files_give_todays_jobs`, change `self.assertEqual(out["e2e_smoke_shards"], [1, 2])` to `[1, 2, 3, 4]`.
  2. In `test_the_web_and_e2e_counts_come_from_the_file`, change `self.repo.edit(matrix.COUNTS, "smoke = 2", "smoke = 3")` to `"smoke = 4", "smoke = 5"`. Change the expected `[1, 2, 3]` to `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]` in the same test.
  3. In `test_it_refuses_what_could_hide_a_job_or_flood_the_runners`, change the case `("[e2e]\nsmoke = 2", "[e2e]", "has no `smoke`")` to `("[e2e]\nsmoke = 4", "[e2e]", "has no `smoke`")`.
- **Optional, under `.github/`.** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 28 is stale. It says the smoke list is "specs 01, 06, 10, 13 and 19 … in two shards". `SMOKE` also holds 46 and 47, and there are now four shards.

## Decisions and risks
- **`WEIGHTS` unchanged.** I left `WEIGHTS` in `e2e/scripts/shard-specs.mjs` alone. I had no per-spec timings, and making numbers up would be inventing evidence. The split follows the existing weights.
- **Why 4.** By those weights the longest shard is spec 19 alone (99 s) at 4 shards and at any higher count. More shards would add job-boot overhead and draw on the shared runner pool for no gain.
- **Spec 19 is a floor.** It sits alone in shard 1. About 50 s of its 99 s is a rating-window wait, so it can't be split further. If `e2e smoke (1/4)` still runs over 5 minutes, a person must choose between moving spec 19 to the daily `super.yml` and trimming that wait. The durations from that CI run are what a real `WEIGHTS` refresh needs.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `claude-6`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 167s |

| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 2s |

| cargo tests (`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`) | pass | 1259s |
| web tests (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts'`) | pass | 178s |
